name: FAL Cinema (Scene & Series Shots)
description: Cinematic scene generation with consistent library characters via FAL.ai: Kling v3 Pro elements, Veo 3.1 reference-to-video + first/last-frame, Seedance 2.5 long takes, Vidu Q2 drafts, MiniMax H3 budget continuity, PixVerse transitions, Sora 2 character registry, and ffmpeg last-frame extraction for shot-to-shot continuity.

required_variables.description: FAL.ai API key (get from https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys). Falls back to FAL_KEY if set.

connector.name: FAL.ai
connector.description: FAL.ai media generation API (images, video, lip-sync).

skill.name: fal_cinema
skill.description: Scene/shot video generation with consistent library characters (reference-to-video, keyframe continuity, Sora character registry) via FAL.ai.
skill.system_prompt:
You generate cinematic scene videos with consistent, recurring characters using FAL.ai. Characters come from the persistent avatar/character library (see fal_avatar skill: create_avatar, character_sheet, update_character).

## Production doctrine
1. Resolve characters from the library by name. Every scene tool accepts `characters: [names]` and automatically feeds the character's full reference image set (portrait + turnarounds) to the model. If a character has no turnarounds yet, run `character_sheet` first - identity holds much better with multiple angles.
2. Stills before clips: compose an approved keyframe still per shot (edit_image_nano_banana from the fal_image skill: character refs + location) - iterating on a still costs cents, iterating on video costs dollars. Then animate it with `scene_video` (start_image = the still).
3. Style lock: when working inside a series, read the series style block (series_get) and pass it as `style` on EVERY generation, plus its `negative` and `seed` where supported. Never rely on memory - re-read it.
4. Continuity chain: after generating shot N, run `extract_last_frame` and use the result as shot N+1's `start_image` / `first_frame`. Use `continuity_video` (or `continuity_video_budget`) when you know both boundary keyframes; use `transition_video` for deliberate stylized scene bridges.
5. Draft cheap, finalize premium: iterate prompts with `scene_video_budget` (Vidu, ~$0.10-0.30/clip) or `continuity_video_budget` (MiniMax, ~$0.025-0.04/s), then re-render the approved shot with `scene_video` (Kling, ~$0.11-0.17/s), `scene_video_veo` (Veo 3.1, $0.20-0.60/s) or `scene_video_long` (Seedance, single takes up to 30s). All billing is per second of generated video - never generate longer than the shot needs.

## Tool selection
- `scene_video` (Kling v3 Pro): the default for identity-critical shots. Requires a `start_image` keyframe; characters become @Element1, @Element2... - reference them by element tag in the prompt. Supports `end_image` for keyframe-bounded shots and native audio.
- `scene_video_veo` (Veo 3.1 reference-to-video): premium; pure reference-based (no keyframe needed), native audio, up to 4K.
- `scene_video_long` (Seedance 2.5): continuous takes of 4-30s with timestamped beats in the prompt ("0-2.5s: ...; 2.5-6s: ..."). References are @Image1, @Image2... in prompt order (the tool returns the mapping). Returns the seed used.
- `scene_video_budget` (Vidu Q2): cheap drafts, up to 7 reference images, supports seed.
- `continuity_video` / `continuity_video_budget`: first+last frame bridges (Veo FLF / MiniMax H3).
- `transition_video` (PixVerse v6): stylized transition between two stills (style presets: anime, 3d_animation, clay, comic, cyberpunk).
- `extract_last_frame`: local ffmpeg; feeds the continuity chain.
- `sora_create_character` + `sora_scene_video`: Sora 2's server-side character registry. Register once per character (needs a <=4s >=720p video - a `talking_video` render of the portrait works), then reference the character BY NAME in prompts. Max 2 characters per shot.

## Rules
- Wardrobe/style notes stored on character manifests are automatically appended to prompts - keep them current via `update_character`.
- Dialogue: models with native audio (Kling/Veo/Seedance/Sora) can speak lines written in the prompt, but for the character's cloned voice generate speech separately (bound voice via elevenlabs generate_speech) and lipsync or mux it in post.
- Always report generated file paths, the model used, and (when returned) the seed, so shots are reproducible.
- Videos land in the task workspace; persistent artifacts (episode clips, stills) must be copied into the series tree via the series_library tools.

tools.name: scene_video
tools.description: Generate an identity-consistent scene shot with Kling v3 Pro (image-to-video + character elements, native audio, ~$0.11-0.17/s). Requires a start_image keyframe still. Characters are passed as elements and MUST be referenced as @Element1, @Element2... in the prompt (mapping returned). Supports end_image for keyframe-bounded continuity. Returns JSON {video_file, video_url, model, characters, request_id}.

prompt.description: Shot description. Reference characters by their element tag (@Element1...). Dialogue in quotes is spoken with native audio.

start_image.description: Keyframe still to animate from: local path, URL, or library character name. REQUIRED - compose one with edit_image_nano_banana or chain extract_last_frame from the previous shot.

characters.description: Library character names (see fal_avatar list_avatars). Each character's reference image set (portrait + turnarounds) is uploaded and passed to the model.

extra_reference_images.description: Extra reference images: local paths, URLs, or library character names (portrait). Use for locations, props, objects.

end_image.description: Optional last-frame keyframe (first-to-last continuity within the shot).

duration.description: Shot length in seconds, 3-15. Default 5. Per-second billing - keep tight.

style.description: Series/project style block appended to the prompt (style lock). Pass the series style on every shot.

negative.description: Negative prompt. Default: 'blur, distort, and low quality'.

audio.description: Generate native audio (default true; audio-on costs more).

tools.name: scene_video_veo
tools.description: Premium reference-to-video with Google Veo 3.1 (native audio, 720p/1080p/4K, $0.20-0.60/s). No keyframe needed - identity comes purely from reference images (characters' portrait + turnarounds). 8s shots. Returns JSON {video_file, video_url, model, characters, request_id}.

prompt.description: Shot description; refer to characters naturally (e.g. 'the woman in the red coat'). Dialogue in quotes is spoken.

characters.description: Library character names (see fal_avatar list_avatars). Each character's reference image set (portrait + turnarounds) is uploaded and passed to the model.

extra_reference_images.description: Extra reference images: local paths, URLs, or library character names (portrait). Use for locations, props, objects.

style.description: Series/project style block appended to the prompt (style lock). Pass the series style on every shot.

negative.description: Things to avoid (appended to the prompt; Veo has no native negative prompt).

audio.description: Generate native audio (default true; audio-on costs more).

tools.name: scene_video_long
tools.description: Long single-take scene with Seedance 2.5 reference-to-video: 4-30s continuous shots, up to 30 reference images, native multilingual audio, timestamp-paced beats ('0-2.5s: ...; 2.5-6s: ...'). References are @Image1, @Image2... in upload order (mapping returned). ~$0.22/s at 480p, ~$0.47/s at 720p. Returns JSON incl. the seed used.

prompt.description: Scene description, optionally with timestamped beats. Reference images as @Image1... Dialogue in quotes is spoken with per-character voice consistency.

characters.description: Library character names (see fal_avatar list_avatars). Each character's reference image set (portrait + turnarounds) is uploaded and passed to the model.

extra_reference_images.description: Extra reference images: local paths, URLs, or library character names (portrait). Use for locations, props, objects.

audio_references.description: Optional reference audio URLs/paths (voice or music, 1.8-30s each) - @Audio1... in the prompt.

duration.description: Seconds 4-30, or 'auto' (default) to let the model decide.

style.description: Series/project style block appended to the prompt (style lock). Pass the series style on every shot.

audio.description: Generate synchronized audio (default true; same cost either way).

tools.name: scene_video_budget
tools.description: Cheap draft shots with Vidu Q2 reference-to-video (up to 7 reference images, seed support, ~$0.10-0.30/clip). Use to iterate prompts/blocking before re-rendering the approved shot on a premium tool. Returns JSON {video_file, ...}.

prompt.description: Shot description; refer to characters naturally.

characters.description: Library character names (see fal_avatar list_avatars). Each character's reference image set (portrait + turnarounds) is uploaded and passed to the model.

extra_reference_images.description: Extra reference images: local paths, URLs, or library character names (portrait). Use for locations, props, objects.

movement.description: Movement amplitude: auto (default), small, medium, large.

seed.description: Seed for reproducibility (series style lock seed).

style.description: Series/project style block appended to the prompt (style lock). Pass the series style on every shot.

tools.name: continuity_video
tools.description: Bridge two known keyframes with Veo 3.1 first-last-frame-to-video (4s/6s/8s, native audio, seed + negative prompt support). Ideal when shot N's last frame and shot N+1's opening still both exist. Returns JSON {video_file, ...}.

prompt.description: What happens between the two frames.

first_frame.description: First frame: local path, URL, or library character name.

last_frame.description: Last frame: local path, URL, or library character name.

style.description: Series/project style block appended to the prompt (style lock). Pass the series style on every shot.

tools.name: continuity_video_budget
tools.description: Budget continuity with MiniMax H3 Max image-to-video (first + optional end keyframe, 5-15s, seed support, ~$0.025-0.04/s promo). The cheapest way to chain shots while drafting. Returns JSON {video_file, ...}.

first_frame.description: Optional first frame (omit for pure text-to-video).

last_frame.description: Optional end frame for first-to-last keyframe generation.

style.description: Series/project style block appended to the prompt (style lock). Pass the series style on every shot.

tools.name: transition_video
tools.description: Stylized transition between two stills with PixVerse v6 (1-15s, style presets, seed). Use for deliberate scene bridges (location change, time jump). Returns JSON {video_file, ...}.

prompt.description: How the first image transforms into the second.

first_image.description: First frame: local path, URL, or library character name.

end_image.description: Last frame: local path, URL, or library character name.

style_preset.description: Optional PixVerse style: anime, 3d_animation, clay, comic, cyberpunk.

style_prompt.description: Series/project style block appended to the prompt (style lock). Pass the series style on every shot.

tools.name: extract_last_frame
tools.description: Extract the final frame of a local video as a PNG (ffmpeg). Feed it into the next shot's start_image/first_frame to chain scene-to-scene continuity. Returns JSON {image_file, video_duration_s}.

video.description: Local video file path (e.g. the previous shot's video_file).

output.description: Optional output PNG path (default: workspace lastframe-<id>.png).

tools.name: sora_create_character
tools.description: Register a library character in Sora 2's server-side character registry (free). Needs a short video of the character (<=4s used, >=720p) - a talking_video (OmniHuman) render of the portrait works well. Writes the returned char_... id into the character manifest (sora_character_id). Returns JSON {character, sora_character_id}.

video.description: Reference video: local path or URL (<=4s is used; >=720p; e.g. an OmniHuman render of the portrait).

sora_name.description: Optional display name used to refer to the character in Sora prompts (default: the character's library name).

force.description: Re-register even if the character already has a sora_character_id (default false).

tools.name: sora_scene_video
tools.description: Generate a Sora 2 shot with registered characters ($0.10/s, native audio, 4-20s). Pass up to 2 library characters (must have sora_character_id via sora_create_character) and refer to them BY NAME in the prompt. Optional start_image switches to image-to-video. Returns JSON {video_file, characters, ...}.

prompt.description: Shot description; refer to registered characters by their Sora name (returned in the characters mapping).

characters.description: Up to 2 library character names with a registered sora_character_id.

start_image.description: Optional first-frame image (local path, URL, or library character name).

style.description: Series/project style block appended to the prompt (style lock). Pass the series style on every shot.
